_comment: Web of Science categories for individual conference and book-series records,
read from Web of Science Core Collection through Yonsei's subscription on
2026-08-14. Clarivate's own classification, like the venue file.
This file exists because conference proceedings are classified PER RECORD,
not per venue. ISSI 2017 is in CPCI-S and carries two categories; ISSI 2023
is not indexed at all. One venue, two answers — so data/wos-categories.json,
which is keyed by venue, cannot hold this.
Journals are the opposite: the category belongs to the journal and every
paper in it inherits the same one. Those stay in the venue file.
Keyed by DOI, lowercased. The two ISSI papers have no DOI and are keyed by
Records with an empty categories list were searched by title and returned no
hit in the Core Collection. For the 2025 and 2026 papers that is probably
just lag — CPCI indexes a conference months after it happens — so those are
worth re-checking rather than treated as settled. checked records the date so
a re-run knows how stale this is.
